snippet.title: Heroes of Might And Magic: Olden Era - Release Date Trailer | Fantasy Turn-Based Strategy
snippet.description:
Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era is the next game in the legendary turn-based strategy franchise! Featuring new factions, biomes, and creatures that bring fresh breath to the world and its lore, you will explore a vibrant world full of fantastical beasts, formidable spellcasters, and fierce champions, while raising magnificent cities and massive armies to vanquish your foes. 

Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era is set to release into Early Access on Steam and the Microsoft Store on April 30th, 2026! 

Wishlist Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3105440/Heroes_of_Might_and_Magic_Olden_Era/
Microsoft Store: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p2tfccrkmrd
